### Value-indexed checked records

Closed `Bool`, `String`, and `Nat` indices are compile-time metadata; they do
not become WIT fields. Pass only the generated record's payload fields. `Nat`
payloads use exact little-endian `list<u32>` limbs, including values wider than
64 bits. Full components apply the selected Lean constructor at each input
site, preserve rejected caller values, and recover on the next valid call.
Results and standalone result-only components expose the same payload records
without proof fields or checked-input metadata.

The [hosted installed acceptance](../evidence/checked-record-value-index-wit-promotion-20261020.md)
covers ordinary and independently reviewed packages, full and result-only
APIs, offline installation, source-free caller replay, and physical relocation
through Wasmtime 42.0.1 at the glibc 2.38 package floor.

Reviewed IR: Installed checks passed (input, result, field); Not audited (callback input, callback result) | Pass the generated record's runtime payload fields, without proof values. The selected Lean constructor checks each input and may normalize it; rejection identifies the parameter and constructor and preserves caller data. Results contain copied payload fields with proofs erased. Both ordinary and independently reviewed packages, including standalone result-only packages, passed installed checks. The tested Component Model Packet is a WIT record whose Fin 10 digit and checked Nat Subtype word are canonical `list<u32>` limbs. A Holder record nests Packet, and the packet case of Choice carries it in its active branch. Generated WIT adapters apply the exact Packet and nested Word constructors selected at each direct, repeated, Array, List, Option, Product, Except, Holder and Choice input site. Rejected calls preserve the complete caller value tree and output sentinel, and later valid calls recover. Packet arrays and options returned by Lean contain proof-free WIT records without input-constructor selections. The tested Span, Ticket and Stamped inheritance chain remains a chain of nested parent subobjects rather than flattened fields. Generated adapters preserve the parent aliases and public nominal identities, erase the ordered, linked and stamped proof fields, apply the exact per-site Span, Word, Ticket and Stamped constructors in dependency order, retain independent choices for repeated parameters, check the nested Fin 8 mark, preserve rejected caller values and recover on the next valid call. Full packages check inputs and proof-free results; result-only packages project the same inherited payloads without input-constructor metadata. The tested checked-record graphs preserve nominal identity through a self-recursive Packet and a mutually recursive Envelope ↔ Step pair, including aliases, Array and Option wrappers, active variant branches, exact Nat Subtype constructors and Fin 3 fields. Generated adapters validate every selected input site in dependency order, erase proof fields, expose constructor-free copied results, preserve rejected caller graphs and recover on the next valid call. Required: Construct inputs only through the selected safe Lean constructor over the exact payload fields. Preserve closed indices and per-site choices; project proof-backed results without fabricating proofs. |

Full packages check inputs and proof-free results; result-only packages project the same inherited payloads without input-constructor metadata. Generated adapters validate every selected input site in dependency order, erase proof fields, expose constructor-free copied results, preserve rejected caller graphs and recover on the next valid call."
